title: Psychometric properties of the German Version of the Emotion Regulation Questionnaire-30 (ERQ-30)
summary: Online study examining the psychometric properties of the German version of the emotion regulation questionnaire ERQ-30 and investigating associations with mental health and personality traits.
conditions: Healthy volunteers from the general population (adults)

interventions.name: Arm 1: Adults from the general population (age ≥ 18 years, fluent German language skills) are surveyed once as part of an online assessment (approx. 20–30 minutes) using the following standardized self-report questionnaires: Emotion Regulation Questionnaire-30 (ERQ-30), Perth Emotion Regulation Comp

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Fluent German language skills
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion for careless responding, operationalized via (a) at least two of three infrequency items (Kay, 2024) answered not as expected, or (b) a completion time of less than one third of the sample median; discontinuation of the study before completing the ERQ-30 items.
